document.notes: Example model of SBML4Humans for the objects of SBML core which carry their own attributes: a constraint with a message, an event with a trigger, a priority and a delay, a kinetic law with local parameters and a unit definition built from several units.

models.name: model with a constraint, an event and local parameters
models.notes:
Model with a constraint, an event and local parameters

A single Michaelis-Menten reaction converts S1 into S2 in the compartment cell. The rate law keeps its constants Km and Vmax as local parameters, so they belong to this reaction alone.

A constraint states that S1 stays below S1_max and carries the message which a simulator shows when it does not. The event E1 adds a dose of S1 five minutes after the twentieth minute and switches the reaction off; its trigger, its priority and its delay each carry their own identifier, SBO term and notes.

The rate law of R1 was measured below S1_max, so a simulation which leaves that range is no longer a prediction of the system.

 S1 S1_max

listOfReactions.name: conversion of S1 into S2
listOfReactions.xml:
<reaction metaid="meta_R1" sboTerm="SBO:0000176" id="R1" name="conversion of S1 into S2" reversible="false" compartment="cell">
  <listOfReactants>
    <speciesReference id="R1_S1" species="S1" stoichiometry="1" constant="true"/>
  </listOfReactants>
  <listOfProducts>
    <speciesReference id="R1_S2" species="S2" stoichiometry="1" constant="true"/>
  </listOfProducts>
  <kineticLaw metaid="meta_R1_kinetic_law" sboTerm="SBO:0000028">
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
      <apply>
        <times/>
        <ci> active </ci>
        <ci> cell </ci>
        <apply>
          <divide/>
          <apply>
            <times/>
            <ci> Vmax </ci>
            <ci> S1 </ci>
          </apply>
          <apply>
            <plus/>
            <ci> Km </ci>
            <ci> S1 </ci>
          </apply>
        </apply>
      </apply>
    </math>
    <listOfLocalParameters>
      <localParameter sboTerm="SBO:0000186" id="Vmax" name="maximal velocity" value="1" units="mmole_per_min_l"/>
      <localParameter sboTerm="SBO:0000027" id="Km" name="Michaelis constant" value="2" units="mM"/>
    </listOfLocalParameters>
  </kineticLaw>
</reaction>
